_comment: HCM 7th Edition, Chapter 25, Example Problem 6: Planning-Level Analysis of a Freeway Facility (Exhibits 25-88 through 25-96). Seven freeway sections derived from the Example Problem 1 geometry, analyzed from directional AADT over four 15-min analysis periods. inflow_aadt/outflow_aadt give the on-/off-ramp (or entry) AADT at each section's upstream boundary; the weave section carries the volume ratio V_r used by Equation 25-46.
